note: The status of a hand-off of an audio-only file under the reject failure policy while it was rejected.

body.message: Weir only processes movie and TV files that contain a video stream. This file contains no video, so it was rejected before any output was written. Deluno on 127.0.0.1 accepted that this release is bad and can find a different one. Deluno on 127.0.0.1 will remove the download; Weir left it in place.
